info.name: Transcendence Public API
info.description:
Demo of the public API: seeds a user and objects with JWT, creates an API key, then reads objects with X-API-Key.

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner works). The stack is served by Caddy with a self-signed certificate, so turn off SSL certificate verification in Postman settings, or set base_url to your own address.

item.name: 2. API key management (JWT)
item.description: Keys are created and revoked by a logged in user. The full key is only returned once, at creation.

exec: pm.test('Full key returned once, with pep_ prefix', function () { pm.expect(body.key).to.be.a('string').and.match(/^pep_/); });

request.description: Only the prefix is shown. The database stores a sha256 hash, never the key itself.

exec: pm.test('Created key is listed', function () { pm.expect(keys.map(k => String(k.id))).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('api_key_id')); });
pm.test('Listing never exposes the full key', function () { keys.forEach(k => pm.expect(k).to.not.have.property('key')); });

request.description: Used by the write tests to prove one user's key cannot modify another user's object.

exec: pm.test('Full key returned once, with pep_ prefix', function () { pm.expect(body.key).to.be.a('string').and.match(/^pep_/); });

item.name: 4. Rate limiting (per IP)
item.description: Checks the gateway rate limiter on /api/public. The last request waits for the window to reset so the collection can be re-run right away. Keep PUBLIC_API_RATE_LIMIT at its default when running the whole collection.

item.name: 5. Cleanup
item.description: Revokes the key and removes the demo objects. Run the folder again from the top for a fresh demo. A revoked key can keep working for up to 30 seconds, because the objects service caches successful checks.
